settings.pageHint: Personalize catalog layout and features on this device.
settings.metaDesc: Change how ModrinthProxy looks and behaves on this device.
settings.languageWarn: If a translation is missing, some UI stays in English or Russian. The site is not fully translated yet.
settings.themeHint: Pick the color theme for ModrinthProxy on this device.
settings.paletteHint: The identity color — buttons, links, highlights. Not the whole look, just the palette.
settings.featuresHint: Turn features on or off on this device.
settings.fxHint: Menu blur and background images on project pages. Turn off to speed up the site on weak devices.
settings.searchRightHint: Show the filter sidebar to the right of search results.
settings.contentLeftHint: Show the sidebar to the left of the project description.
settings.disclaimerHint: Show the “Unofficial site, not affiliated with modrinth.com” bar at the top of pages.
settings.graphTitle: Hide the activity graph on project pages
settings.graphHint: Hides the background release graph in the header of mods, plugins, and other projects.
settings.layoutsHint: Pick list or grid for each catalog on this device.
settings.resetHint: The site remembers a few things right in this browser, so it knows how you like it. Sometimes those little memories get mixed up — starting fresh fixes that. This only affects this browser on this device.
settings.resetGone: theme, color, list view, language, kitten sounds and dismissed hints
settings.resetKept: your account, favorites and download history — they are not stored in the browser
